rationales.1: The twelve-segment month bar under every packet shows season fit instantly, with aligned price and stock lines and a sidebar month filter backed by section links.
rationales.2: Purchase mechanics are entirely conventional on the product page, and the bars stay informational rather than touching the money path.
rationales.3: The estimated germination gets both a label and a margin note explaining it, the null price stays honest as price pending, scarcity is stated plainly, and UK-only shipping leads both pages.
rationales.4: Type is generous, margin notes are always visible rather than hover-revealed, and the bars are redundantly backed by bold sow-month text, though the unlabeled segments ask a little inference.
rationales.5: The almanac structure, marginalia column, and disciplined green-and-plum palette carry consistently across surfaces, widths, and modes.
rationales.6: The year bar plus table, difficulty line, margin quote, and companion entries give a first-timer everything needed to commit on the page.
rationales.7: Find your month first, then your packet is a one-sentence idea expressed in structure, visualization, copy, and filtering alike, and it is true of a shop organized around sowing windows.
rationales.8: The month-bar and marginalia novelty lives entirely in the brand and information layer while navigation and purchase stay conventional.
rationales.9: Shelved under the window it wants and the margin asides are specific and unhurried, just short of the strongest voice on the panel.
rationales.10: A repeat visitor asking what can I sow now is served faster here than anywhere else, and the bar motif ties catalog and product page into one shop.
